top_signals.title: Russian Satellite Raises Space Warfare Fears
top_signals.summary: Clayton Swope, deputy director of the CSIS Aerospace Security Project, said that we shouldn't look at movement in Space as separate from what countries do on on earth, after a Russian satellite approached an American satellite used by Ukraine. Swope said that the move should be evaluated as an 'example of Russia doing hybrid warfare zone activities that threaten US interests and European interests' and is all part of the same geopolitical problem as the Russia Ukraine war.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: United Airlines Misses Estimates, Squeezed by Soaring Fuel Costs
top_signals.summary: United Airlines Holdings Inc. forecast weaker-than-expected earnings for the final three months of the year, underscoring how soaring jet fuel prices are eating into airline profits despite resilient demand for air travel.

top_signals.summary: United Airlines cut its profit outlook for the year as fuel prices continued to climb.
